findings.claim: A malformed supportedCatalogIds value is treated as permission to send a surface using any catalog.
findings.evidence: offersA2UICatalog returns `!Array.isArray(supported) || supported.includes(catalogId)`, so capabilities such as `{ "1.0": { "supportedCatalogIds": "urn:other-catalog" } }` authorize the reference catalog. handler.ts uses this result to emit its deterministic surface. This conflates an absent restriction with an explicitly supplied but invalid restriction at the inbound message-metadata boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish an absent supportedCatalogIds field from a malformed one: retain the documented unrestricted behavior only when the field is absent, and return false when a present field is not an array of strings.
